title: Make land --pr wait for failed runs, rerun once, name failing test
summary: Retry of the failed job: in land_pr's bounded check wait, when checks go Red, keep waiting until the failed workflow runs complete, rerun failed jobs once via GitHub's rerun-failed-jobs endpoint, wait again, then merge if green or report the failing test's name if red. Audience: the operator who wants unattended landings.

defaults_applied.how: Unit tests plus cargo test, clippy and fmt criteria.
Criteria check reruns, merges and reported names by test.
Docs and CHANGELOG entry for an outside reader.
Fixes the premature-Red-before-run-complete cause, not one instance.
Reuses the existing host-call path, not new machinery.
One focused change inside land_pr's check wait.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The retry lives inside land_pr's check wait in crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs and reuses HostOperation::ReadChecks and the existing host-call retry and error-log path.
The total wait across the first wait, the rerun and the second wait stays within a bound (about twice the existing 30 looks of 20 s).
Rerun staleness is detected with run_attempt from the actions/runs reply, with a look allowance as fallback.
GitHub refuses rerun-failed-jobs on a run still in progress, so the code waits for completion first.
Docs go in docs/design/native-pr-landing.md and CHANGELOG.md.
The file list is carried from the earlier attempt; I did not re-read the repository.

acceptance_criteria.text: A FakeHost test where the first read is Red while the run is still in progress shows no rerun is requested until the run completes, then exactly one rerun. Total reads stay within 2 x attempts. The test fails without the wait-for-completion behavior. Run `cargo test -p athena-core gh`.

A test with the read sequence [Red, Red, Pending, Red] asserts exact counts: first wait 1 read, second wait 3 reads, 1 rerun, no second rerun. A stale run_attempt (unchanged after the rerun) is treated as not yet restarted. Run `cargo test -p athena-core gh`.
A test where the rerun turns green shows land_pr reports Green and merges when merge_via_rest is on. Run `cargo test -p athena-core gh`.

A test where the second result is Red shows no merge, no further rerun, and the PrReport carries the failing test's name. Checks still pending after the bound give Pending with no rerun and no merge. Run `cargo test -p athena-core gh`.
display::land_pr and the JSON report name the failing test and say the failed job was re-run once. The failure message names the test whether or not a rerun happened.

GhClient calls the rerun-failed-jobs endpoint through the existing HostOperation retry and redaction path. A parser test on a sample payload covers the failing test name. The plan or docs list, for each new GitHub call, the state it requires and what GitHub returns when that state is missing.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` pass with no warnings.
docs/design/native-pr-landing.md and CHANGELOG.md state the wait, the single rerun, the completion precondition and the failing-test report.

out_of_scope: Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass chance than the reference: the previous attempt failed in planning on a design gap, and the change spans several files.
